sections.html: Scientific name: Pareuchiloglanis rhabdura Ng, 2004. Family: Sisoridae. Size: 90 mm (3.5 in) SL. IUCN Red List status: Data Deficient.

Asia: Red River drainage in northern Vietnam.

Type locality: Cao Bo stream (Bac Trao river) near camp 1, Vi Xuyen District, Red River (Song Hong) drainage, Ha Giang Province, Vietnam.
Breeding: unreported. There is no breeding report.

Identification: differs from its congeners chiefly by a slender body (8.7% SL) and caudal peduncle (4.2% SL; 4.2 times in caudal peduncle length), as well as a combination of the following characters: length of adipose-fin base 34.7% SL; dorsal to adipose distance 12.2% SL; caudal peduncle length 17.6% SL; snout length 57.0% HL; interorbital distance 25.5% HL; adipose and caudal fins separate; and ventral limit of gill opening to base of first pectoral-fin element.

Etymology: from the Greek rhabdos, meaning rod, and oura, meaning tail, in reference to the slender caudal peduncle of this species. Used as an adjective.
